notes:
## 0.2.248

owes: SyncDesk — `ui.act` now runs every stocks command it answered `-32601` for, and no action is the web's alone any more: the watchlist's add by search or by a confirmed symbol (`stocks.watch.add`), removal (`stocks.watch.remove`; an instrument holding a position in the replica is a preview, `navigate` to `stocks.watchlist{remove: <id>}`, and `stocks.watchlist.removeConfirm` removes it with its position), categorise, move, hearts, the categories and the address settings (`stocks.setSetting`, an `api_key*` key still refused); the search and the typed symbol are previews (`navigate` to `stocks.watchlist{query}` and `stocks.watchlist{symbol}`, rendered from the facts relay, reaching the quote endpoint through the egress guard); the statement import's `stocks.import` form runs `stocks.import.review{path}` for any `step` but `apply` (the `file` argument is the local path) and answers `navigate` to `stocks.import{reviewId}`, then `stocks.import.apply{reviewId, choices, sub, replace, cash}` (the `r.<n>` fields are the choices, `replace` the instrument ids joined by commas) and answers `navigate` to `stocks.import{reviewId, report}`; `GET /api/v1/ui/facts` serves `stocks.import` (under the session) for a `reviewId` the hub holds, the review (its `carried` is the id and the choices, never the statement) or, with `report`, the report of an applied review, and `-32004` for any other id; `POST /api/v1/stocks/import/apply` now keeps the applied review's report in memory until the review's 15 minutes are up, and a second apply of the same review is still `404`; an action whose argument is missing answers `-32602`; additions only, no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.
owes: SyncDesk — `ui.act` now runs every weather command it answered `-32601` for: the places' add by name or by page (`weather.place.add`; at the cap of ten the outcome is `weather.places{capReached}`, not an error), the confirmed re-analysis (new `weather.place.setRule{id, pageRule}`), move, remove, heart, the refresh interval, source order and address settings (`weather.setSetting`), the board's refresh (new `weather.refresh{placeId}`, relayed to the new `POST /api/v1/weather/places/{placeId}/refresh`, `404` for a place not the caller's), the sensor's remove and save (`weather.setSensor`, the save with `check` first looking through the new `weather.sensor.check`, relayed to `POST /api/v1/weather/places/{placeId}/sensor/check`, and writing only if it found a reading, else `-32602` with `data.error` `check_failed`); the places' search, page analysis and re-analysis are previews: `ui.act` calls nothing and answers `navigate` to `weather.places` with the param `name`, `url` or `reanalyse` (a place id), which `ui.screen` renders from the facts relay, reaching the geocoder or the page through the egress guard as the web's `POST` does; `GET /api/v1/ui/facts` reads those three params on `weather.places`; the sensor's save and remove now navigate to `weather.sensor` (with `check=1` after a save that asked for it), where they navigated to `weather.place`; additions only, no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.
owes: SyncDesk — `ui.act` now runs the hub level's and the notes' commands it answered `-32601` for: `account.fileTokens.create{label}`, `about.check` (`admin.update.check`), `about.apply` (`admin.update.apply`), `backup.schedule` (new `admin.backup.schedule{time, includeFiles}`, relayed to the new `POST /api/v1/backup/schedule`, admin only), `backup.upload{snapshot, password, code}` and `notes.attach{file}`, a `file` argument being the client's own absolute local path (an unreadable one is `-32602`), and `notes.label.add` / `notes.label.remove`, written as `notes.update` of the note's whole label set read from the replica; `POST /api/v1/account/file-tokens` takes the web's free `label` (an `app` sent by an older engine still reads as the label); additions only, no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.
